task.description:
WF-02 Step 2a -- Implementation for REQ-367 (CD to QA on merge). Claim this handoff (status IN_PROGRESS). Verify branch: git branch --show-current must equal feature/WF02-REQ367-20260917. Read lib/letflow/design/req367-cd-qa-deploy.md IN FULL (the approved, PASSED design -- CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR passed it after one rework; §1/§2 are prose-only by design, YOU write the actual code).

Implement exactly what the design specifies:
1. NEW FILE deploy/redeploy-qa.sh -- per design §1's ordered procedure. Make it executable-shaped (proper shebang, set -euo pipefail, matching deploy/redeploy-test.sh's own conventions -- read that file again for exact style/idioms to match). Follow every specific detail in §1: APP_DIR=/opt/apps/letflow-qa, git pull, backend docker build+compose recreate, throwaway node:22 frontend build with real VITE_OIDC_AUTHORITY/VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID args (source them from a host-local env file per §1's open-question resolution -- use a sensible convention and comment it clearly, e.g. sourcing $APP_DIR/qa.env), atomic swap with timestamped backup of the previous web-dist, both health checks (backend /health JSON parse, frontend https://qa.bizdala.com/ curl), matching redeploy-test.sh's retry-loop shape. Header comment must state this script's relationship to redeploy-test.sh explicitly (different host/path/target, sibling not replacement) per design §4.
2. NEW FILE .github/workflows/cd.yml -- per design §2's structural outline. workflow_run trigger off ci.yml completion on main, job-level gate on conclusion=='success', the changes-job-reuse mechanism (see item 3 below for the one small ci.yml addition this requires), SSH deploy step via appleboy/ssh-action@v1 with QA_DEPLOY_HOST/QA_DEPLOY_USER/QA_DEPLOY_SSH_KEY secrets (not yet provisioned -- that's fine, expected), invoking redeploy-qa.sh. Match letflow-queue's real cd.yml's header-comment style (quoted in design §0) adapted for QA.
3. ONE SMALL ADDITION to .github/workflows/ci.yml's existing `changes` job -- CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR explicitly ruled this in-scope, not creep (see handoffs/WF02-REQ367-20260917/step-01b-code-design-validator.json's ci_yml_scope_ruling). Add the artifact-upload step per design §2's 'How the gate reuses...' subsection: after computing backend/frontend, write those two values to a small file and upload as a build artifact so cd.yml's deploy job can consume it via actions/download-artifact@v4 with run-id. Do NOT touch ci.yml's existing filter/fallback steps' git diff/regex logic at all -- purely additive.
4. Do NOT touch deploy/redeploy-test.sh at all.

After implementing: mix compile --warnings-as-errors (only if this touches any .ex/.exs file -- it does not, this is pure shell+YAML, so note that this check is N/A and say so explicitly rather than silently skipping it). Validate the new YAML is syntactically valid (e.g. a YAML parse check -- python -c "import yaml,sys; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/cd.yml'))" or equivalent; also re-validate ci.yml still parses after your addition). Validate the shell script's syntax with `bash -n deploy/redeploy-qa.sh`. Run `mix format --check-formatted` only if it applies (it won't touch these files, but confirm nothing else broke).

Self-review checklist: no secrets/credentials hardcoded anywhere; deploy/redeploy-test.sh unchanged (confirm via git diff); ci.yml's existing changes-job diff/regex logic unchanged (confirm via git diff, only an addition); both new files' header comments state the required cross-references (cd.yml states it deploys only QA; redeploy-qa.sh states its relationship to redeploy-test.sh).

Complete the handoff: artifacts_out listing every file created/modified, next_action 'Route to SECURITY-REVIEWER (2c)'. Commit and push on feature/WF02-REQ367-20260917.
acceptance_criteria: deploy/redeploy-qa.sh exists, targeting /opt/apps/letflow-qa/ on ubuntu-16gb-nbg1-1, performing all 4 named steps (git pull, backend rebuild+recreate, frontend throwaway-container rebuild+atomic-swap with real build args and backup, health checks for both)
.github/workflows/cd.yml exists, triggered after ci.yml succeeds on main, gated on the same backend/frontend signal ci.yml's changes job computes without a duplicated diff computation
The workflow uses the same SSH-action pattern letflow-queue's cd.yml uses in production, referencing QA_DEPLOY_HOST/QA_DEPLOY_USER/QA_DEPLOY_SSH_KEY (distinct names, not required to exist yet)
deploy/redeploy-test.sh is left untouched (verify via git diff showing zero changes to that file)
ci.yml's existing diff/regex logic in the changes job is unchanged -- only a new additive step
Both new files' header comments explicitly state the redeploy-test.sh/redeploy-qa.sh relationship and QA-only deploy scope

artifacts_out: .github/workflows/ci.yml (modified -- additive only, two new steps in the `changes` job)

validation_evidence.mix_compile_warnings_as_errors: N/A -- no .ex/.exs file touched; this is pure shell+YAML infrastructure work
validation_evidence.mix_format_check_formatted: N/A -- no Elixir file touched; skipped for the same reason as the compile check
validation_evidence.yaml_parse_ci_yml: python -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci.yml'))" -> OK_CI_YML (re-validated after the addition)
validation_evidence.ci_yml_diff_review: git diff -- .github/workflows/ci.yml shows only two new appended steps ('Write path-filter outputs for cd.yml', 'Upload path-filter outputs') after the existing fallback step -- zero lines changed in the existing filter/fallback steps' diff/regex logic
validation_evidence.no_hardcoded_secrets: grep -i 'password|secret|token|key' over deploy/redeploy-qa.sh -> only comment references to the SSH deploy-key mechanism and the qa.env sourcing convention; VITE_OIDC_* and QA_BACKEND_PORT are sourced from a host-local $APP_DIR/qa.env file, never hardcoded; cd.yml's three new secret names (QA_DEPLOY_HOST/QA_DEPLOY_USER/QA_DEPLOY_SSH_KEY) are referenced, not provisioned, per design/requirement

open_items_for_downstream_review: deploy/docker-compose.qa.yml does not exist in this checkout (confirmed via `ls deploy/`) and was NOT authored by this handoff -- it is outside owned_modules and design §7 item 2 leaves its authorship as an open question rather than silently assuming it exists or creating it. redeploy-qa.sh's $COMPOSE variable references it by the same convention as redeploy-test.sh/docker-compose.test.yml; the compose file must exist on the QA host (or be authored as a follow-up) before this script can actually run.

Backend health-check port (design §7 item 4) is resolved by sourcing QA_BACKEND_PORT from qa.env with a 3113 fallback default (matching redeploy-test.sh's value) rather than a confirmed QA-specific port -- flagged in the script's own comment for host-state confirmation.

qa.env's exact path/existence on ubuntu-16gb-nbg1-1 (design §7 item 3) is assumed by convention, not confirmed against actual host state or the T-0125/T-0128/T-0129/T-0131 task records (not reachable from this checkout).
Web-dist backup retention/pruning (design §7 item 5) is intentionally left unbounded, per the design's explicit decision not to invent an unrequested retention policy.
